invocation.stdin_mode: JSONL stream of chat export entries, one JSON object per line

flags.--input <path>: Read JSONL from file instead of stdin
flags.--output <path>: Write JSON receipt to file instead of stdout
flags.--max-entries <n>: Stop after processing N entries (useful for sampling large exports)
flags.--max-events <n>: Maximum mapped events stored in receipt (default: 1000; 0 = counts only). Does not affect mapped/failure counts.
flags.--dry-run: Parse and count only; store no events (implies --max-events 0)

exit_codes.0: Success — receipt emitted to stdout or --output
exit_codes.1: Input error — file not found, unreadable, or fatal I/O failure

guarantees: Will NOT write to the blocker ledger
Will NOT access /mnt/data or any mounted OS path
Will emit a valid JSON receipt even if all entries are UNMAPPABLE or the export is empty
Will process entries one line at a time; mapped event storage is bounded by --max-events (default: 1000) so memory grows with the cap, not with input size
Will NOT modify any governance artifacts, hook scripts, or existing test files
Will count parse errors without crashing
Will output the receipt as valid JSON on stdout (or --output) and nothing else on stdout

receipt_shape.entries_seen: int — count of successfully parsed JSON lines
receipt_shape.parse_errors: int — count of lines that failed JSON parsing
receipt_shape.failures_found: int — count of entries where hook_event_name == 'PostToolUseFailure'
receipt_shape.mapped: int — total failures successfully mapped (includes events beyond the cap)
receipt_shape.unmappable: int — count of failures that could not be mapped (no tool_name)
receipt_shape.events: list — mapped blocker event dicts, each with _adapter_status field (capped at events_cap)
receipt_shape.events_cap: int|null — maximum events stored (0=dry-run/counts-only, N=bounded, null=unlimited)
receipt_shape.events_capped: bool — true if mapped events exceeded events_cap and were not stored

not_in_contract: Receipt does not include recurrence decisions (LOG_ONLY, FORCE_RCA, LOG_NEW_VARIANT) — those are Stage002+
Receipt does not include fingerprint-based deduplication — Stage002+
Receipt does not include pattern clusters or RCA rankings — Stage003+
